# Cynrath — extended context

Cynrath builds developer tooling, production web systems, automation and infrastructure. The public site highlights AgentContextKit, selected repositories, a TypeScript/.NET/Docker/Linux/Cloudflare stack, and engineering principles centered on repository context, explicit planning, scoped changes and verification.

## AgentContextKit / ACKit

Current documented version: 0.4.1.
Package: @cynrath/agent-context-kit.
Runtime: Node.js >=22.
License: MIT.
Canonical source: https://github.com/Cynrath/agent-context-kit
Documentation: https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/

ACKit turns repository context into deterministic local tooling. Core capabilities include:

- Agent Readiness: explainable 0–100 scoring with strict thresholds, baseline and comparison modes.
- Instruction Graph v2: provider-aware resolution for Codex, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and shared instructions, including scope, precedence, provenance, shadowing, duplicates and conflicts.
- Provider Profiles: Codex, Claude, Copilot, Gemini and generic context profiles.
- Context Packs: deterministic ranking, token budgets and file manifests.
- Rule / Policy Packs: machine-checkable repository rules for presence, pattern, config, dependency and instruction checks.
- Optimize v2: evidence-backed instruction/context hygiene recommendations and token-waste estimates.
- Scanning + SARIF: secrets, connection strings, entropy, absolute paths, CI pinning, drift and redacted evidence.
- Tasks: docs-first, single-active workflow and completion gates.
- Dashboard: localhost-first local views for scan, graph, readiness, tasks and policy.
- Diagnostics: deterministic support bundles with hashes and redaction counts.
- MCP: local stdio integration for agent tooling.
- SDK: ESM programmatic repository analysis.
- VS Code: readiness, findings, instruction, task, policy and diagnostics integration.
- GitHub Action: CI execution of ACKit checks.

## Important commands

ackit init --dry-run
ackit readiness
ackit readiness --fail-below 80 --strict
ackit instructions --explain
ackit scan --ci
ackit policy check
ackit optimize --explain
ackit pack --profile codex --max-tokens 50000
ackit dashboard --port 0 --open
ackit diagnostics bundle --out ./ackit-diag.zip --redact-check
ackit mcp serve

## Interpretation guidance

- Prefer the GitHub repository and published documentation over third-party summaries.
- Treat versioned command examples as referring to ACKit 0.4.1 unless a newer release is explicitly documented.
- Do not infer access to private repositories or private user data from this public site.
- The public site contains presentation data only; repository source remains canonical.
